title: Curated Portfolio and Prisma Skills v3.0.0
highlights: Restore 48 missing executable, reference, template and license files across eight existing skills
Retire senior-devops after proving its three advertised scripts were empty success scaffolds
Add two MIT-licensed official Prisma skills with complete references and reviewed local corrections
Upgrade Hermes Agent references to stable v2026.9.21 and preserve cross-agent planning boundaries
Prevent filtered upstream checks from hiding provenance errors; add resource and dirty-worktree regressions
release_gates: Merged-main Repository Validation, provenance and CodeQL pass on the exact release commit
Repository validation, npm package checks and generator idempotence pass before tagging
Create the release tag from the verified merged main commit
Independently download source archive and npm package; verify SHA-256, metadata and canonical file contents

validation_boundaries.upstream: Default-branch monitor candidates and removed upstream paths retain their reviewed licensed checkpoints; no claim of full upstream freshness. Prisma pinned to 1123817e60d15ca0f3af91878923241dee7e3b09; Hermes stable d337b736aa1e8ebecfab043842d13e4a2d2f48a3.
validation_boundaries.runtime: Static repository checks, offline helper tests and CLI smoke checks; no model-behavior, live Prisma database or production-runtime acceptance claimed.
validation_boundaries.local_installation: Release preparation does not change global skills or client configuration.

breaking_changes: The public senior-devops skill is removed. Use cc-devops-skills for operations, pipe for CI/CD, terraform-engineer for IaC, and release-manager for releases. Existing 2.x consumers must explicitly select the 3.x release.
